# LetHQ

> > LetHQ is an ISO27001-compliant UK tenant referencing and compliance service provider offering digital identity verification, right to rent checks, AML screening, and rent guarantee insurance for landlords and letting agents.

LetHQ provides comprehensive tenant screening and regulatory compliance solutions powered by IDVT technology, Experian credit checks, and OFSI/OFAC sanctions screening. Winner of ESTAS 2025 Best in Sector for Tenant Referencing, LetHQ helps UK landlords and letting agents meet Home Office and UK Government compliance requirements including right to rent checks and AML regulations effective May 2025.

## Key Topics

- Tenant referencing and screening
- Right to Rent checks (IDVT-powered)
- AML checks and financial sanctions (OFSI/OFAC)
- Digital identity verification
- Rent guarantee insurance
- ISO27001 compliance
- Home Office regulations
- Landlord compliance
- Letting agent services
- Credit checks (Experian)
- PEP screening
- UK rental market trends
- Guarantor references
- Property management compliance
